about_short_description.short_description: Hertha Metals is a manufacturing industry that designs and manufactures steel from any grade of iron ore without the use of coal.

product.name: Hydrogen Electric Reduction Smelting (HERS™)
product.description: A steelmaking process that uses hydrogen, natural gas, and electricity to produce steel from any grade of iron ore without coal, reducing carbon emissions by up to 98%.

product.name: Methane Electric Reduction Smelting (MERS™)
product.description: A steelmaking process that uses natural gas and electricity to produce steel from various iron ore grades, reducing carbon intensity and enabling cost-efficient production with current resources.

product.name: XERS Platform Technology
product.description: A proprietary steelmaking platform that operates on natural gas, hydrogen, and electricity to produce steel from all grades of iron ore and waste oxides without coal.
